findings.message: domain.User.Session is orm.One but public.sessions(user_id) is not unique
findings.reason: nothing stops two rows from referencing the same one, so a to-one relation would silently pick whichever came back first
findings.fix: add a total unique constraint on public.sessions(user_id), or declare the field as orm.Many[Session]

findings.message: domain.User.Badge is orm.One but public.badges(user_id) is not unique
findings.reason: badges_one_active_per_user is a partial unique index, so it says nothing about the rows its WHERE clause excludes; a to-one relation would silently drop rows
findings.fix: add a total unique constraint on public.badges(user_id), or declare the field as orm.Many[Badge]
